data.name: Aquib
data.gender_notes: Aquib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Aqibah' meaning 'young lion' or 'descendant'. This name is mentioned in the Quran as a title given to Prophet Yunus (Jonah) when he was thrown into the sea and swallowed by a whale. It symbolizes the strength, courage, and resilience of a young lion in the face of adversity. The name Aquib carries the meaning “Young Lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aquib usually hope their child will grow to embody young lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage, resilience, and strength in faith.
data.etymology: Aquib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aquib total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
